questions.knowledge_point: Representing a 2x2 System of Equations Using a Matrix Product
questions.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that both $x$ and $y$ appear in each equation. 
The variable $x$ does not appear in the first equation, but this just means its coefficient is $0.$ So, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}0x-6y=4 \\ 3x+5y\,=-7\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & -6 \\ 3 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -7\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -6 \\ 3 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -7\end{aligned}].
$$

\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+4y=1 \\ x-8y=-2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

First, notice that both $x$ and $y$ appear in each equation, all the variables are on the left-hand side, and all the constants are on the right-hand side.

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+4y=1 \\ x-8y=-2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}6 & 4 \\ 1 & -8\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & 4 \\ 1 & -8\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Expressing a Matrix Product as a 2x2 System of Equations
questions.problem:
What is the system of equations represented by

$$
[\begin{aligned}10 & 25 \\ 12 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}15 \\ -6\end{aligned}]?
$$
questions.worked_solution:
The  $2\times 2$ matrix represents the coefficients of $x$ and $y,$ while the $2\times 1$ column vector on the right-hand side represents the constants of the equations. So, we get the following system of equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}10x+25y=15 \\ 12x+3y=-6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Simplifying both equations in the system, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x+5y=3 \\ 4x+y=-2.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
